# Reference fixtures

The JSON files in this directory are copied unmodified from
[benzac-de/msx](https://github.com/benzac-de/msx), the official Media Station X
GitHub Pages example by Benjamin Zachey. They are used only as test fixtures for
the round-trip and builder-reproduction tests.

They are redistributed under the
[Media Station X license](https://msx.benzac.de/info/?tab=License), which states:
"You can use, copy, modify, and distribute all menu and content examples (i.e.
JSON files) provided on the msx.benzac.de pages and by the author." They are
not covered by this repository's MIT license; copyright remains with their
author.
